title: Early screenshot from my vertical city-building game
author: kutan74

comments.author: kutan74
comments.body:
Been working this cozy vertical city-builder/ traffic management game for the past few weeks.

The city can crow across multiple elevation layers, with roads, ramps, platforms buildings and traffic all interacting with each other. Most of the 3D assets are being created with AI-assisted tools, while the gameplay system and simulation are build in Unreal Engine.

It's still very early, but the visual direction is finally starting to feel cohesive. I'm trying to keep it clean, miniature-like and relaxing while still having meaningful traffic and city-planning decisions.
